partners.subject: A Tidewater poster for Ringolevio's wall?
partners.body: Hi Ringolevio team! We're running a week of preview screenings of Tidewater, an independent coming-of-age film, at Nitehawk Cinema Williamsburg starting November 27. Taste data shows your visitors closely match people who love Greta Gerwig's films (a 0.893 affinity), so it felt like a natural fit. Would you be up for putting a poster up in the shop during the run-up? In return we'd love to offer [your offer, e.g. two guest-list spots]. Details are here: {link}. Thanks so much!

partners.subject: Juice + Tidewater tickets: a cross-promo idea
